WITH customer_consumption AS (
  SELECT
    T1.CustomerID,
    T2.Segment,
    SUM(T1.Consumption) AS total_consumption
  FROM yearmonth AS T1
  INNER JOIN customers AS T2
    ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
  WHERE T2.Currency = 'CZK'
    AND T1.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
  GROUP BY T1.CustomerID, T2.Segment
),
segment_min AS (
  SELECT
    Segment,
    MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
  FROM customer_consumption
  GROUP BY Segment
)
SELECT
  MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN min_consumption END) - MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN min_consumption END) AS SME_minus_LAM,
  MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN min_consumption END) - MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN min_consumption END) AS LAM_minus_KAM,
  MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN min_consumption END) - MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN min_consumption END) AS KAM_minus_SME
FROM segment_min

SELECT
  T2.Segment,
  (
    SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(T1.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN T1.Consumption ELSE 0 END) -

WITH customer_2013 AS (
  SELECT
    T1.Segment,
    T2.CustomerID,
    SUM(T2.Consumption) AS total_consumption
  FROM customers AS T1
  INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2
    ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
  WHERE T1.Currency = 'CZK'
    AND T2.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
  GROUP BY T1.Segment, T2.CustomerID
),
min_per_segment AS (
  SELECT
    Segment,
    MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
  FROM customer_2013
  GROUP BY Segment
)
SELECT
  (SELECT min_consumption FROM min_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT min_consumption FROM min_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS sme_lam_diff,
  (SELECT min_consumption FROM min_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT min_consumption FROM min_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS lam_kam_diff,
  (SELECT min_consumption FROM min_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT min_consumption FROM min_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS kam_sme_diff

WITH customer_annual_consumption AS (
  SELECT
    T1.Segment,
    T1.CustomerID,
    SUM(T2.Consumption) AS total_consumption
  FROM customers AS T1
  INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2
    ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
  WHERE T1.Currency = 'CZK'
    AND T2.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
  GROUP BY T1.CustomerID, T1.Segment
),
segment_min_consumption AS (
  SELECT
    Segment,
    MIN(total_consumption) AS min_annual_consumption
  FROM customer_annual_consumption
  GROUP BY Segment
)
SELECT
  (SELECT min_annual_consumption FROM segment_min_consumption WHERE Segment = 'SME')
    - (SELECT min_annual_consumption FROM segment_min_consumption WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_sme_lam,
  (SELECT min_annual_consumption FROM segment_min_consumption WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
    - (SELECT min_annual_consumption FROM segment_min_consumption WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_lam_kam,
  (SELECT min_annual_consumption FROM segment_min_consumption WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
    - (SELECT min_annual_consumption FROM segment_min_consumption WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_kam_sme

WITH customer_2013 AS (
  SELECT
    T1.CustomerID,
    T1.Segment,
    SUM(T2.Consumption) AS total_consumption
  FROM customers AS T1
  INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2
    ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
  WHERE T1.Currency = 'CZK'
    AND T2.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
    AND T1.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
  GROUP BY T1.CustomerID, T1.Segment
),
min_per_segment AS (
  SELECT
    Segment,
    MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
  FROM customer_2013
  GROUP BY Segment
)
SELECT
  (SELECT min_consumption FROM min_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT min_consumption FROM min_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_sme_lam,
  (SELECT min_consumption FROM min_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT min_consumption FROM min_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_lam_kam,
  (SELECT min_consumption FROM min_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT min_consumption FROM min_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_kam_sme

WITH customer_2013_consumption AS (
  SELECT
    c.CustomerID,
    c.Segment,
    SUM(y.Consumption) AS annual_consumption
  FROM customers AS c
  INNER JOIN yearmonth AS y
    ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
  WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
    AND y.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
  GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
segment_min AS (
  SELECT
    Segment,
    MIN(annual_consumption) AS min_annual_consumption
  FROM customer_2013_consumption
  GROUP BY Segment
)
SELECT
  MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN min_annual_consumption END) - MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN min_annual_consumption END) AS diff_sme_lam,
  MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN min_annual_consumption END) - MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN min_annual_consumption END) AS diff_lam_kam,
  MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN min_annual_consumption END) - MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN min_annual_consumption END) AS diff_kam_sme
FROM segment_min

WITH customer_consumption AS (
  SELECT
    T2.Segment,
    SUM(T1.Consumption) AS annual_consumption
  FROM yearmonth AS T1
  INNER JOIN customers AS T2
    ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
  WHERE T2.Currency = 'CZK'
    AND T1.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
  GROUP BY T1.CustomerID, T2.Segment
),
min_segment AS (
  SELECT
    Segment,
    MIN(annual_consumption) AS min_consumption
  FROM customer_consumption
  GROUP BY Segment
)
SELECT
  (SELECT min_consumption FROM min_segment WHERE Segment = 'SME') - 
  (SELECT min_consumption FROM min_segment WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_sme_lam,
  (SELECT min_consumption FROM min_segment WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - 
  (SELECT min_consumption FROM min_segment WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_lam_kam,
  (SELECT min_consumption FROM min_segment WHERE Segment = 'KAM') -

WITH cust_2013 AS (

    T1.Segment,
    SUM(T2.Consumption) AS total_consumption
  FROM customers AS T1

    ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
  WHERE T1.Currency = 'CZK'
    AND T2.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
  GROUP BY T1.CustomerID, T1.Segment
),
min_per_segment AS (
  SELECT
    Segment,
    MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
  FROM cust_2013
  GROUP BY Segment
)
SELECT
  MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN min_consumption END) - MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN min_consumption END) AS diff_sme_lam,
  MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN min_consumption END) - MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN min_consumption END) AS diff_lam_kam,
  MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN min_consumption END) - MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN min_consumption END) AS diff_kam_sme
FROM min_per_segment

WITH SegmentIncrease AS (
  SELECT
    T1.Segment,
    (CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(T2.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN T2.Consumption ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(T2.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN T2.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS REAL)
     / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(T2.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN T2.Consumption ELSE 0 END), 0)) * 100.0 AS PctIncrease
  FROM customers AS T1
  INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2
    ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
  WHERE T1.Currency = 'EUR'
    AND T1.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
  GROUP BY T1.Segment
)
SELECT
  (SELECT Segment FROM SegmentIncrease ORDER BY PctIncrease DESC LIMIT 1) AS Biggest_Increase_Segment,

WITH customer_annual_consumption AS (
  SELECT

    T2.Segment,
    SUM(T1.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
  FROM yearmonth AS T1
  INNER JOIN customers AS T2
    ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
  WHERE T2.Currency = 'CZK'
    AND T1.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
  GROUP BY T1.CustomerID, T2.Segment
),
min_consumption AS (
  SELECT
    Segment,
    MIN(TotalConsumption) AS MinConsumption
  FROM customer_annual_consumption
  GROUP BY Segment
)
SELECT
  (SELECT MinConsumption FROM min_consumption WHERE Segment = 'SME') -
  (SELECT MinConsumption FROM min_consumption WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_sme_lam,
  (SELECT MinConsumption FROM min_consumption WHERE Segment = 'LAM') -
  (SELECT MinConsumption FROM min_consumption WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_lam_kam,
  (SELECT MinConsumption FROM min_consumption WHERE Segment = 'KAM') -

WITH customer_consumption AS (
  SELECT
    T2.Segment,
    T1.CustomerID,
    SUM(T1.Consumption) AS total_consumption
  FROM yearmonth AS T1
  INNER JOIN customers AS T2
    ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
  WHERE T2.Currency = 'CZK'
    AND T1.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
  GROUP BY T2.Segment, T1.CustomerID
),
min_consumption AS (
  SELECT
    Segment,
    MIN(total_consumption) AS min_cons
  FROM customer_consumption
  GROUP BY Segment
)
SELECT
  (SELECT min_cons FROM min_consumption WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT min_cons FROM min_consumption WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_sme_lam,
  (SELECT min_cons FROM min_consumption WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT min_cons FROM min_consumption WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_lam_kam,

WITH customer_2013_consumption AS (
  SELECT
    c.CustomerID,
    c.Segment,
    SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_consumption
  FROM customers AS c
  INNER JOIN yearmonth AS ym
    ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
  WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
    AND ym.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
  GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
min_segment_consumption AS (
  SELECT
    Segment,
    MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
  FROM customer_2013_consumption
  GROUP BY Segment
),
avg_least_consumption AS (
  SELECT
    cc.Segment,
    AVG(cc.total_consumption) AS avg_consumption
  FROM customer_2013_consumption AS cc
  INNER JOIN min_segment_consumption AS msc
    ON cc.Segment = msc.Segment
   AND cc.total_consumption = msc.min_consumption
  GROUP BY cc.Segment
)
SELECT
  (SELECT avg_consumption FROM avg_least_consumption WHERE Segment = 'SME') -
  (SELECT avg_consumption FROM avg_least_consumption WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_sme_lam,
  (SELECT avg_consumption FROM avg_least_consumption WHERE Segment = 'LAM') -
  (SELECT avg_consumption FROM avg_least_consumption WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_lam_kam,
  (SELECT avg_consumption FROM avg_least_consumption WHERE Segment = 'KAM') -
  (SELECT avg_consumption FROM avg_least_consumption WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_kam_sme

WITH customer_annual AS (
  SELECT
    T1.Segment,
    T1.CustomerID,
    SUM(T2.Consumption) AS total_consumption
  FROM customers AS T1
  INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2
    ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
  WHERE T1.Currency = 'CZK'
    AND T2.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
  GROUP BY T1.Segment, T1.CustomerID
),
segment_min AS (
  SELECT
    Segment,
    MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
  FROM customer_annual
  GROUP BY Segment
)
SELECT
  (SELECT min_consumption FROM segment_min WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT min_consumption FROM segment_min WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_sme_lam,
  (SELECT min_consumption FROM segment_min WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT min_consumption FROM segment_min WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_lam_kam,

  WHERE T2.Currency = 'CZK'
    AND T1.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
  GROUP BY T2.Segment, T1.CustomerID
),
min_segment_consumption AS (
  SELECT
    Segment,
    MIN(total_consumption) AS min_cons
  FROM customer_consumption
  GROUP BY Segment
)
SELECT
  (SELECT min_cons FROM min_segment_consumption WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT min_cons FROM min_segment_consumption WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_sme_lam,
  (SELECT min_cons FROM min_segment_consumption WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT min_cons FROM min_segment_consumption WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_lam_kam,

WITH customer_annual_consumption AS (
  SELECT
    T1.CustomerID,
    T1.Segment,
    SUM(T2.Consumption) AS total_consumption
  FROM customers AS T1
  INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2
    ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
  WHERE T1.Currency = 'CZK'
    AND T2.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
  GROUP BY T1.CustomerID, T1.Segment
),
segment_min_consumption AS (
  SELECT
    Segment,
    MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
  FROM customer_annual_consumption
  GROUP BY Segment
)
SELECT
  (SELECT min_consumption FROM segment_min_consumption WHERE Segment = 'SME')
  - (SELECT min_consumption FROM segment_min_consumption WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS sme_minus_lam,
  (SELECT min_consumption FROM segment_min_consumption WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
  - (SELECT min_consumption FROM segment_min_consumption WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS lam_minus_kam,
  (SELECT min_consumption FROM segment_min_consumption WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
  - (SELECT min_consumption FROM segment_min_consumption WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS kam_minus_sme

WITH customer_annual AS (
  SELECT

    SUM(T2.Consumption) AS annual_consumption
  FROM customers AS T1

    ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
  WHERE T1.Currency = 'CZK'
    AND T2.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
  GROUP BY T1.Segment, T1.CustomerID
),
segment_lowest AS (
  SELECT
    Segment,
    MIN(annual_consumption) AS avg_consumption
  FROM customer_annual
  GROUP BY Segment
)
SELECT
  (SELECT avg_consumption FROM segment_lowest WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM segment_lowest WHERE Segment = 'LAM'),
  (SELECT avg_consumption FROM segment_lowest WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM segment_lowest WHERE Segment = 'KAM'),

  T1.bond_type
FROM bond AS T1
INNER JOIN connected AS T2
  ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
WHERE (T2.atom_id = 'TR004_8' AND T2.atom_id2 = 'TR004_20')
   OR (T2.atom_id = 'TR004_20' AND T2.atom_id2 = 'TR004_8')
